name: Smith's Gully
summary: An extension built in rammed earth, with a new kitchen and living room and a courtyard enclosed by the same walls.

groups.title: Rammed earth, inside and out
groups.blurb: The new rooms are finished in rammed earth, from the living room and kitchen through to a courtyard walled in the same material.

name: Thornbury
summary: A weatherboard period home. The street frontage and front rooms were restored, and the rear rebuilt as one raked-ceiling space for cooking, eating and living.

groups.title: The facade stayed exactly where it was
groups.blurb: Weatherboards repaired, leadlight retained, the picket fence and front garden reinstated. From the footpath the house reads as it always did.

groups.title: A new rear pavilion, resolved against the original roof
groups.blurb: The old lean-to came off and a raked-ceiling pavilion went on. High-level glazing along the gable pulls light deep into the plan, and the whole rear wall opens to the garden.

groups.title: One room for cooking, eating and everything else
groups.blurb: Kitchen, dining and living share a single volume under the rake, with the ceiling dropping as it meets the original house so the junction reads deliberately.

groups.title: Fluted island, stone tops and a pantry that hides the mess
groups.blurb: A single stone-topped island with fluted joinery, a window splashback instead of tiles, and a butler's pantry behind holding the second sink and everything that lives on the bench.

groups.title: Terrazzo, fluted glass and vertical tile
groups.blurb: Main bathroom with a fully glazed bath-shower recess, terrazzo to dado height and vertical stack tile above. The ensuite runs the same palette with a double vanity.

groups.title: Bedrooms with proper storage
groups.blurb: Original front bedrooms kept their leadlight and ceiling height. The new ones got built-in robes, so nothing has to live on a chair.

groups.title: Bluestone, lawn and a level change that works
groups.blurb: Bluestone paving off the living room, a raised lawn behind a low retaining wall, and stepping stones through to the studio at the rear.

name: Kinglake
summary: A new build taken through to lock-up. The frame is up, the roof is on, and the openings are in.

groups.title: Frame, roof and openings in
groups.blurb: The house at lock-up: roof on, wall framing up, and the window and door openings formed.

name: Coburg
summary: A weatherboard house. The street frontage was repaired, and the kitchen rebuilt.

groups.title: Street front and a new kitchen
groups.blurb: Weatherboards repaired and the facade painted. Inside, a new kitchen with timber joinery and a stone benchtop.

name: Elwood
summary: An extension and renovation, with the kitchen and living room in one volume and a bedroom with built-in robes.

groups.title: Open plan, and a bedroom with storage
groups.blurb: Kitchen and living share one room, with timber joinery and a stone island. The bedroom has a built-in robe.
